headlines.description: — Andrei Svechnikov scored two goals and Sebastian Aho had a goal and two assists to lead the Carolina Hurricanes to a 7-4 win over the Edmonton Oilers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurricanes surge past Oilers for 7-4 victory

headlines.description: — Sam Rinzel scored in overtime and had two assists to lead the Chicago Blackhawks past the Calgary Flames 4-3 on Saturday, snapping a nine-game road winless skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Rinzel scores in overtime to lift Blackhawks over Flames 4-3

headlines.description: — Sam Bennett had a hat trick and set up the go-ahead goal by Sandis Vilmanis with 3:18 left, and the Florida Panthers beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bennett has hat trick, helps set up Vilmanis' winner as Panthers hold off Sabres 4-3

headlines.description: — Jayden Struble and Jonathan Marchessault each had a goal and an assist to lead the Nashville Predators to a 4-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Penguins on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Struble and Marchessault lead the Predators to a 4-3 win over the Penguins

headlines.description: — Elias Lindholm had the first four-goal game of his NHL career to carry the Boston Bruins past the Washington Capitals 7-5 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elias Lindholm's 1st NHL 4-goal game and 1st trick with Boston carries Bruins to 7-5 win over Caps

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Zach Werenski scored with 3:28 left in regulation as the Columbus Blue Jackets battled back late to top Toronto 4-3 on Saturday night and extend the Maple Leafs’ winless streak to nine games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jackets stun Maple Leafs late and extend Toronto's winless streak to nine

headlines.description: — Noah Cates scored the winner with 30 seconds left in regulation as the Philadelphia Flyers held on to beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-3 Saturday night after squandering a two-goal lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cates' goal with 30 seconds left lifts the Flyers to a 4-3 win over the Canadiens

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Tim Stutzle had a three-point game that included a pair of goals in the third period, leading the Ottawa Senators to a 4-2 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stutzle's 2 goals in the 3rd period help power the Senators to a 4-2 win over the Kings

events.name: New York Islanders at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Ondrej Palat scored two goals and the New York Islanders stretched their point streak to seven games with a 3-2 victory over the struggling Detroit Red Wings on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palat scores twice, Islanders extend point streak to seven games with 3-2 win over Red Wings

events.name: New Jersey Devils at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Jake Neighbours matched a franchise record with five assists, Brandon Carlo scored his first goal in more than two years and the St. Louis Blues chased star goalie Connor Hellebuyck a little more than nine minutes into a 9-6 victory over the New...
headlines.shortLinkText: Neighbours has 5 assists and Blues chase Hellebuyck early in 9-6 victory over Devils

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — William Karlsson scored the only goal in the shootout to give the Vegas Golden Knights a 5-4 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: William Karlsson scores the only goal in the shootout as the Golden Knights beat the Jets 5-4

headlines.description: — Sebastian Cossa made 29 stops to help the Utah Mammoth beat the Anaheim Ducks 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cossa's 29 saves help Mammoth to a 3-2 victory over the Ducks

headlines.description: — Jake DeBrusk scored in a shootout as the Vancouver Canucks defeated the Minnesota Wild 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rossi scores twice, DeBrusk stars in shootout as Canucks top Wild

events.name: Seattle Kraken at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini and Ivar Stenberg each had a power-play goal and an assist, and the San Jose Sharks held off the Seattle Kraken 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Macklin Celebrini and Ivar Stenberg lead the Sharks to a 4-3 win over the Kraken
